# Deriving SDFs: Shaders

## sphere

A raymarched sphere demonstrating Pattern 1 (direct distance).

```{ojs}
//| label: sphere
viewof sphereCanvas = {
  const canvas = DOM.canvas(540, 540);
  const shader = `
    precision highp float;
    uniform vec2 iResolution;
    uniform float iTime;
    uniform vec4 iMouse;

    struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };

    const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
    const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
    const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

    const vec3 light = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));

    float sdSphere(vec3 p, float r) {
        return length(p) - r;
    }

    float sdScene(vec3 p) {
        return sdSphere(p, 1.0);
    }

    vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
        float eps = 0.001;
        return normalize(vec3(
            sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
            sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
            sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
        ));
    }

    float raymarch(Ray ray) {
        float t = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
            vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
            float d = sdScene(p);
            if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;
            t += d;
            if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
        }
        return -1.0;
    }

    vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 baseColor, vec3 lightDir, vec3 viewDir) {
        float diff = max(dot(normal, lightDir), 0.0);
        vec3 h = normalize(lightDir + viewDir);
        float spec = pow(max(dot(normal, h), 0.0), 32.0);
        return baseColor * diff + vec3(0.3) * spec;
    }

    Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
        vec2 uv = (fragCoord - 0.5 * iResolution.xy) / iResolution.y;
        return Ray(vec3(0.0, 0.0, 3.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -1.0)));
    }

    Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float dist) {
        vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
        if (iMouse.z <= 0.0) mouse = vec2(0.3, 0.4);
        float theta = 6.28 * mouse.x;
        float phi = 3.14 * (mouse.y - 0.5);
        ray.origin = dist * vec3(cos(phi)*sin(theta), sin(phi), cos(phi)*cos(theta));
        vec3 forward = normalize(-ray.origin);
        vec3 right = normalize(cross(vec3(0,1,0), forward));
        vec3 up = cross(forward, right);
        mat3 rot = mat3(right, up, forward);
        ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
        return ray;
    }

    void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
        Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
        ray = orbitRay(ray, 4.0);

        float t = raymarch(ray);

        vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
        if (t > 0.0) {
            vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
            vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
            vec3 baseColor = vec3(0.8, 0.3, 0.2);
            vec3 ambient = baseColor * 0.15;
            color = ambient + shade(normal, baseColor, light, -ray.dir);
        }

        fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
    }

    void main() {
        mainImage(gl_FragColor, gl_FragCoord.xy);
    }
  `;
  createShaderCanvas(canvas, shader);
  return canvas;
}
```


## segment-2d

2D visualization of distance to a line segment, showing the projection-and-clamp pattern.

```{ojs}
//| label: segment-2d
viewof segment2dCanvas = {
  const canvas = DOM.canvas(540, 540);
  const shader = `
    precision highp float;
    uniform vec2 iResolution;
    uniform float iTime;

    float sdSegment(vec2 p, vec2 a, vec2 b) {
        vec2 pa = p - a;
        vec2 ba = b - a;
        float t = clamp(dot(pa, ba) / dot(ba, ba), 0.0, 1.0);
        return length(pa - ba * t);
    }

    vec3 visualizeSDF(float d) {
        vec3 col = (d > 0.0) ? vec3(0.9, 0.6, 0.3) : vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.8);
        col *= 1.0 - exp(-4.0 * abs(d));
        col *= 0.8 + 0.2 * cos(80.0 * d);
        col = mix(col, vec3(1.0), 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.02, abs(d)));
        return col;
    }

    void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
        vec2 uv = (fragCoord - 0.5 * iResolution.xy) / iResolution.y;
        uv *= 2.5;

        vec2 a = vec2(-0.8, -0.3);
        vec2 b = vec2(0.6, 0.5);

        float d = sdSegment(uv, a, b);

        vec3 col = visualizeSDF(d);

        // Draw endpoints
        col = mix(col, vec3(1.0, 0.2, 0.2), 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.05, length(uv - a)));
        col = mix(col, vec3(1.0, 0.2, 0.2), 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.05, length(uv - b)));

        fragColor = vec4(col, 1.0);
    }

    void main() {
        mainImage(gl_FragColor, gl_FragCoord.xy);
    }
  `;
  createShaderCanvas(canvas, shader);
  return canvas;
}
```


## box-2d

2D box SDF visualization showing the case decomposition pattern.

```{ojs}
//| label: box-2d
viewof box2dCanvas = {
  const canvas = DOM.canvas(540, 540);
  const shader = `
    precision highp float;
    uniform vec2 iResolution;
    uniform float iTime;

    float sdBox(vec2 p, vec2 halfSize) {
        vec2 d = abs(p) - halfSize;
        return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
    }

    vec3 visualizeSDF(float d) {
        vec3 col = (d > 0.0) ? vec3(0.9, 0.6, 0.3) : vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.8);
        col *= 1.0 - exp(-4.0 * abs(d));
        col *= 0.8 + 0.2 * cos(80.0 * d);
        col = mix(col, vec3(1.0), 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.02, abs(d)));
        return col;
    }

    void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
        vec2 uv = (fragCoord - 0.5 * iResolution.xy) / iResolution.y;
        uv *= 2.5;

        float d = sdBox(uv, vec2(0.6, 0.4));

        vec3 col = visualizeSDF(d);

        fragColor = vec4(col, 1.0);
    }

    void main() {
        mainImage(gl_FragColor, gl_FragCoord.xy);
    }
  `;
  createShaderCanvas(canvas, shader);
  return canvas;
}
```


## box-3d

3D raymarched box.

```{ojs}
//| label: box-3d
viewof box3dCanvas = {
  const canvas = DOM.canvas(540, 540);
  const shader = `
    precision highp float;
    uniform vec2 iResolution;
    uniform float iTime;
    uniform vec4 iMouse;

    struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };

    const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
    const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
    const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

    const vec3 light = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));

    float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 halfSize) {
        vec3 d = abs(p) - halfSize;
        return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
    }

    float sdScene(vec3 p) {
        return sdBox(p, vec3(0.8, 0.5, 0.6));
    }

    vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
        float eps = 0.001;
        return normalize(vec3(
            sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
            sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
            sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
        ));
    }

    float raymarch(Ray ray) {
        float t = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
            vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
            float d = sdScene(p);
            if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;
            t += d;
            if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
        }
        return -1.0;
    }

    vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 baseColor, vec3 lightDir, vec3 viewDir) {
        float diff = max(dot(normal, lightDir), 0.0);
        vec3 h = normalize(lightDir + viewDir);
        float spec = pow(max(dot(normal, h), 0.0), 32.0);
        return baseColor * diff + vec3(0.3) * spec;
    }

    Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
        vec2 uv = (fragCoord - 0.5 * iResolution.xy) / iResolution.y;
        return Ray(vec3(0.0, 0.0, 3.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -1.0)));
    }

    Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float dist) {
        vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
        if (iMouse.z <= 0.0) mouse = vec2(0.35, 0.45);
        float theta = 6.28 * mouse.x;
        float phi = 3.14 * (mouse.y - 0.5);
        ray.origin = dist * vec3(cos(phi)*sin(theta), sin(phi), cos(phi)*cos(theta));
        vec3 forward = normalize(-ray.origin);
        vec3 right = normalize(cross(vec3(0,1,0), forward));
        vec3 up = cross(forward, right);
        mat3 rot = mat3(right, up, forward);
        ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
        return ray;
    }

    void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
        Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
        ray = orbitRay(ray, 4.0);

        float t = raymarch(ray);

        vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
        if (t > 0.0) {
            vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
            vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
            vec3 baseColor = vec3(0.2, 0.6, 0.8);
            vec3 ambient = baseColor * 0.15;
            color = ambient + shade(normal, baseColor, light, -ray.dir);
        }

        fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
    }

    void main() {
        mainImage(gl_FragColor, gl_FragCoord.xy);
    }
  `;
  createShaderCanvas(canvas, shader);
  return canvas;
}
```


## cylinder

3D raymarched capped cylinder.

```{ojs}
//| label: cylinder
viewof cylinderCanvas = {
  const canvas = DOM.canvas(540, 540);
  const shader = `
    precision highp float;
    uniform vec2 iResolution;
    uniform float iTime;
    uniform vec4 iMouse;

    struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };

    const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
    const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
    const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

    const vec3 light = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));

    float sdCylinder(vec3 p, float r, float h) {
        vec2 d = vec2(length(p.xz) - r, abs(p.y) - h);
        return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
    }

    float sdScene(vec3 p) {
        return sdCylinder(p, 0.6, 0.8);
    }

    vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
        float eps = 0.001;
        return normalize(vec3(
            sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
            sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
            sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
        ));
    }

    float raymarch(Ray ray) {
        float t = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
            vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
            float d = sdScene(p);
            if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;
            t += d;
            if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
        }
        return -1.0;
    }

    vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 baseColor, vec3 lightDir, vec3 viewDir) {
        float diff = max(dot(normal, lightDir), 0.0);
        vec3 h = normalize(lightDir + viewDir);
        float spec = pow(max(dot(normal, h), 0.0), 32.0);
        return baseColor * diff + vec3(0.3) * spec;
    }

    Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
        vec2 uv = (fragCoord - 0.5 * iResolution.xy) / iResolution.y;
        return Ray(vec3(0.0, 0.0, 3.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -1.0)));
    }

    Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float dist) {
        vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
        if (iMouse.z <= 0.0) mouse = vec2(0.35, 0.45);
        float theta = 6.28 * mouse.x;
        float phi = 3.14 * (mouse.y - 0.5);
        ray.origin = dist * vec3(cos(phi)*sin(theta), sin(phi), cos(phi)*cos(theta));
        vec3 forward = normalize(-ray.origin);
        vec3 right = normalize(cross(vec3(0,1,0), forward));
        vec3 up = cross(forward, right);
        mat3 rot = mat3(right, up, forward);
        ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
        return ray;
    }

    void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
        Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
        ray = orbitRay(ray, 4.0);

        float t = raymarch(ray);

        vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
        if (t > 0.0) {
            vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
            vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
            vec3 baseColor = vec3(0.7, 0.5, 0.8);
            vec3 ambient = baseColor * 0.15;
            color = ambient + shade(normal, baseColor, light, -ray.dir);
        }

        fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
    }

    void main() {
        mainImage(gl_FragColor, gl_FragCoord.xy);
    }
  `;
  createShaderCanvas(canvas, shader);
  return canvas;
}
```


## torus

3D raymarched torus demonstrating Pattern 3 (symmetry reduction).

```{ojs}
//| label: torus
viewof torusCanvas = {
  const canvas = DOM.canvas(540, 540);
  const shader = `
    precision highp float;
    uniform vec2 iResolution;
    uniform float iTime;
    uniform vec4 iMouse;

    struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };

    const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
    const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
    const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

    const vec3 light = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));

    float sdTorus(vec3 p, float R, float r) {
        vec2 q = vec2(length(p.xz) - R, p.y);
        return length(q) - r;
    }

    float sdScene(vec3 p) {
        return sdTorus(p, 0.8, 0.3);
    }

    vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
        float eps = 0.001;
        return normalize(vec3(
            sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
            sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
            sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
        ));
    }

    float raymarch(Ray ray) {
        float t = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
            vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
            float d = sdScene(p);
            if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;
            t += d;
            if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
        }
        return -1.0;
    }

    vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 baseColor, vec3 lightDir, vec3 viewDir) {
        float diff = max(dot(normal, lightDir), 0.0);
        vec3 h = normalize(lightDir + viewDir);
        float spec = pow(max(dot(normal, h), 0.0), 32.0);
        return baseColor * diff + vec3(0.3) * spec;
    }

    Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
        vec2 uv = (fragCoord - 0.5 * iResolution.xy) / iResolution.y;
        return Ray(vec3(0.0, 0.0, 3.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -1.0)));
    }

    Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float dist) {
        vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
        if (iMouse.z <= 0.0) mouse = vec2(0.3, 0.4);
        float theta = 6.28 * mouse.x;
        float phi = 3.14 * (mouse.y - 0.5);
        ray.origin = dist * vec3(cos(phi)*sin(theta), sin(phi), cos(phi)*cos(theta));
        vec3 forward = normalize(-ray.origin);
        vec3 right = normalize(cross(vec3(0,1,0), forward));
        vec3 up = cross(forward, right);
        mat3 rot = mat3(right, up, forward);
        ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
        return ray;
    }

    void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
        Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
        ray = orbitRay(ray, 4.0);

        float t = raymarch(ray);

        vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
        if (t > 0.0) {
            vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
            vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
            vec3 baseColor = vec3(0.9, 0.5, 0.2);
            vec3 ambient = baseColor * 0.15;
            color = ambient + shade(normal, baseColor, light, -ray.dir);
        }

        fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
    }

    void main() {
        mainImage(gl_FragColor, gl_FragCoord.xy);
    }
  `;
  createShaderCanvas(canvas, shader);
  return canvas;
}
```


## capsule

3D raymarched capsule demonstrating Pattern 5 (segment + rounding).

```{ojs}
//| label: capsule
viewof capsuleCanvas = {
  const canvas = DOM.canvas(540, 540);
  const shader = `
    precision highp float;
    uniform vec2 iResolution;
    uniform float iTime;
    uniform vec4 iMouse;

    struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };

    const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
    const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
    const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

    const vec3 light = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));

    float sdCapsule(vec3 p, vec3 a, vec3 b, float r) {
        vec3 pa = p - a;
        vec3 ba = b - a;
        float t = clamp(dot(pa, ba) / dot(ba, ba), 0.0, 1.0);
        return length(pa - ba * t) - r;
    }

    float sdScene(vec3 p) {
        return sdCapsule(p, vec3(-0.5, -0.6, 0.0), vec3(0.5, 0.6, 0.0), 0.3);
    }

    vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
        float eps = 0.001;
        return normalize(vec3(
            sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
            sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
            sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
        ));
    }

    float raymarch(Ray ray) {
        float t = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
            vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
            float d = sdScene(p);
            if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;
            t += d;
            if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
        }
        return -1.0;
    }

    vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 baseColor, vec3 lightDir, vec3 viewDir) {
        float diff = max(dot(normal, lightDir), 0.0);
        vec3 h = normalize(lightDir + viewDir);
        float spec = pow(max(dot(normal, h), 0.0), 32.0);
        return baseColor * diff + vec3(0.3) * spec;
    }

    Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
        vec2 uv = (fragCoord - 0.5 * iResolution.xy) / iResolution.y;
        return Ray(vec3(0.0, 0.0, 3.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -1.0)));
    }

    Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float dist) {
        vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
        if (iMouse.z <= 0.0) mouse = vec2(0.35, 0.45);
        float theta = 6.28 * mouse.x;
        float phi = 3.14 * (mouse.y - 0.5);
        ray.origin = dist * vec3(cos(phi)*sin(theta), sin(phi), cos(phi)*cos(theta));
        vec3 forward = normalize(-ray.origin);
        vec3 right = normalize(cross(vec3(0,1,0), forward));
        vec3 up = cross(forward, right);
        mat3 rot = mat3(right, up, forward);
        ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
        return ray;
    }

    void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
        Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
        ray = orbitRay(ray, 4.0);

        float t = raymarch(ray);

        vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
        if (t > 0.0) {
            vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
            vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
            vec3 baseColor = vec3(0.3, 0.8, 0.5);
            vec3 ambient = baseColor * 0.15;
            color = ambient + shade(normal, baseColor, light, -ray.dir);
        }

        fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
    }

    void main() {
        mainImage(gl_FragColor, gl_FragCoord.xy);
    }
  `;
  createShaderCanvas(canvas, shader);
  return canvas;
}
```


## rounded-box

3D raymarched rounded box demonstrating rounding operation.

```{ojs}
//| label: rounded-box
viewof roundedBoxCanvas = {
  const canvas = DOM.canvas(540, 540);
  const shader = `
    precision highp float;
    uniform vec2 iResolution;
    uniform float iTime;
    uniform vec4 iMouse;

    struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };

    const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
    const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
    const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

    const vec3 light = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));

    float sdRoundBox(vec3 p, vec3 halfSize, float r) {
        vec3 d = abs(p) - (halfSize - r);
        return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0) - r;
    }

    float sdScene(vec3 p) {
        return sdRoundBox(p, vec3(0.8, 0.5, 0.6), 0.15);
    }

    vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
        float eps = 0.001;
        return normalize(vec3(
            sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
            sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
            sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
        ));
    }

    float raymarch(Ray ray) {
        float t = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
            vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
            float d = sdScene(p);
            if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;
            t += d;
            if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
        }
        return -1.0;
    }

    vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 baseColor, vec3 lightDir, vec3 viewDir) {
        float diff = max(dot(normal, lightDir), 0.0);
        vec3 h = normalize(lightDir + viewDir);
        float spec = pow(max(dot(normal, h), 0.0), 32.0);
        return baseColor * diff + vec3(0.3) * spec;
    }

    Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
        vec2 uv = (fragCoord - 0.5 * iResolution.xy) / iResolution.y;
        return Ray(vec3(0.0, 0.0, 3.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -1.0)));
    }

    Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float dist) {
        vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
        if (iMouse.z <= 0.0) mouse = vec2(0.35, 0.45);
        float theta = 6.28 * mouse.x;
        float phi = 3.14 * (mouse.y - 0.5);
        ray.origin = dist * vec3(cos(phi)*sin(theta), sin(phi), cos(phi)*cos(theta));
        vec3 forward = normalize(-ray.origin);
        vec3 right = normalize(cross(vec3(0,1,0), forward));
        vec3 up = cross(forward, right);
        mat3 rot = mat3(right, up, forward);
        ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
        return ray;
    }

    void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
        Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
        ray = orbitRay(ray, 4.0);

        float t = raymarch(ray);

        vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
        if (t > 0.0) {
            vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
            vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
            vec3 baseColor = vec3(0.2, 0.6, 0.8);
            vec3 ambient = baseColor * 0.15;
            color = ambient + shade(normal, baseColor, light, -ray.dir);
        }

        fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
    }

    void main() {
        mainImage(gl_FragColor, gl_FragCoord.xy);
    }
  `;
  createShaderCanvas(canvas, shader);
  return canvas;
}
```


## ring-2d

2D ring (hollowed circle) demonstrating the onion/hollowing operation.

```{ojs}
//| label: ring-2d
viewof ring2dCanvas = {
  const canvas = DOM.canvas(540, 540);
  const shader = `
    precision highp float;
    uniform vec2 iResolution;
    uniform float iTime;

    float sdRing(vec2 p, float R, float t) {
        return abs(length(p) - R) - t;
    }

    vec3 visualizeSDF(float d) {
        vec3 col = (d > 0.0) ? vec3(0.9, 0.6, 0.3) : vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.8);
        col *= 1.0 - exp(-4.0 * abs(d));
        col *= 0.8 + 0.2 * cos(80.0 * d);
        col = mix(col, vec3(1.0), 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.02, abs(d)));
        return col;
    }

    void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
        vec2 uv = (fragCoord - 0.5 * iResolution.xy) / iResolution.y;
        uv *= 2.5;

        float d = sdRing(uv, 0.6, 0.15);

        vec3 col = visualizeSDF(d);

        fragColor = vec4(col, 1.0);
    }

    void main() {
        mainImage(gl_FragColor, gl_FragCoord.xy);
    }
  `;
  createShaderCanvas(canvas, shader);
  return canvas;
}
```


## triangle-2d

2D equilateral triangle demonstrating Pattern 6 (symmetry folding).

```{ojs}
//| label: triangle-2d
viewof triangle2dCanvas = {
  const canvas = DOM.canvas(540, 540);
  const shader = `
    precision highp float;
    uniform vec2 iResolution;
    uniform float iTime;

    float sdTriangle(vec2 p, float r) {
        // Fold into fundamental domain
        p.x = abs(p.x);
        p -= 2.0 * min(dot(p, vec2(-0.5, -sqrt(3.0)/2.0)), 0.0)
                 * vec2(-0.5, -sqrt(3.0)/2.0);
        p.x = abs(p.x);

        // Distance to bottom edge
        return -(p.y + r * 0.5);
    }

    vec3 visualizeSDF(float d) {
        vec3 col = (d > 0.0) ? vec3(0.9, 0.6, 0.3) : vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.8);
        col *= 1.0 - exp(-4.0 * abs(d));
        col *= 0.8 + 0.2 * cos(80.0 * d);
        col = mix(col, vec3(1.0), 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.02, abs(d)));
        return col;
    }

    void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
        vec2 uv = (fragCoord - 0.5 * iResolution.xy) / iResolution.y;
        uv *= 2.5;

        float d = sdTriangle(uv, 0.8);

        vec3 col = visualizeSDF(d);

        fragColor = vec4(col, 1.0);
    }

    void main() {
        mainImage(gl_FragColor, gl_FragCoord.xy);
    }
  `;
  createShaderCanvas(canvas, shader);
  return canvas;
}
```


## octahedron

3D raymarched octahedron demonstrating Pattern 6 (symmetry folding) in 3D.

```{ojs}
//| label: octahedron
viewof octahedronCanvas = {
  const canvas = DOM.canvas(540, 540);
  const shader = `
    precision highp float;
    uniform vec2 iResolution;
    uniform float iTime;
    uniform vec4 iMouse;

    struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };

    const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
    const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
    const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

    const vec3 light = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));

    float sdOctahedron(vec3 p, float s) {
        p = abs(p);
        return (p.x + p.y + p.z - s) * (1.0 / sqrt(3.0));
    }

    float sdScene(vec3 p) {
        return sdOctahedron(p, 1.0);
    }

    vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
        float eps = 0.001;
        return normalize(vec3(
            sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
            sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
            sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
        ));
    }

    float raymarch(Ray ray) {
        float t = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
            vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
            float d = sdScene(p);
            if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;
            t += d;
            if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
        }
        return -1.0;
    }

    vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 baseColor, vec3 lightDir, vec3 viewDir) {
        float diff = max(dot(normal, lightDir), 0.0);
        vec3 h = normalize(lightDir + viewDir);
        float spec = pow(max(dot(normal, h), 0.0), 32.0);
        return baseColor * diff + vec3(0.3) * spec;
    }

    Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
        vec2 uv = (fragCoord - 0.5 * iResolution.xy) / iResolution.y;
        return Ray(vec3(0.0, 0.0, 3.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -1.0)));
    }

    Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float dist) {
        vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
        if (iMouse.z <= 0.0) mouse = vec2(0.35, 0.45);
        float theta = 6.28 * mouse.x;
        float phi = 3.14 * (mouse.y - 0.5);
        ray.origin = dist * vec3(cos(phi)*sin(theta), sin(phi), cos(phi)*cos(theta));
        vec3 forward = normalize(-ray.origin);
        vec3 right = normalize(cross(vec3(0,1,0), forward));
        vec3 up = cross(forward, right);
        mat3 rot = mat3(right, up, forward);
        ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
        return ray;
    }

    void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
        Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
        ray = orbitRay(ray, 4.0);

        float t = raymarch(ray);

        vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
        if (t > 0.0) {
            vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
            vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
            vec3 baseColor = vec3(0.9, 0.7, 0.3);
            vec3 ambient = baseColor * 0.15;
            color = ambient + shade(normal, baseColor, light, -ray.dir);
        }

        fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
    }

    void main() {
        mainImage(gl_FragColor, gl_FragCoord.xy);
    }
  `;
  createShaderCanvas(canvas, shader);
  return canvas;
}
```


## icosahedron

3D raymarched icosahedron with golden ratio folds.

```{ojs}
//| label: icosahedron
viewof icosahedronCanvas = {
  const canvas = DOM.canvas(540, 540);
  const shader = `
    precision highp float;
    uniform vec2 iResolution;
    uniform float iTime;
    uniform vec4 iMouse;

    struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };

    const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
    const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
    const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

    const vec3 light = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));

    #define PHI (0.5 + 0.5 * sqrt(5.0))

    float sdIcosahedron(vec3 p, float r) {
        p = abs(p);

        vec3 n1 = normalize(vec3(0, 1, PHI));
        vec3 n2 = normalize(vec3(1, PHI, 0));
        vec3 n3 = normalize(vec3(PHI, 0, 1));

        p -= 2.0 * min(dot(p, n1), 0.0) * n1;
        p -= 2.0 * min(dot(p, n2), 0.0) * n2;
        p -= 2.0 * min(dot(p, n3), 0.0) * n3;

        return (p.x + p.y + p.z - r) / sqrt(3.0);
    }

    float sdScene(vec3 p) {
        return sdIcosahedron(p, 1.2);
    }

    vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
        float eps = 0.001;
        return normalize(vec3(
            sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
            sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
            sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
        ));
    }

    float raymarch(Ray ray) {
        float t = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
            vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
            float d = sdScene(p);
            if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;
            t += d;
            if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
        }
        return -1.0;
    }

    vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 baseColor, vec3 lightDir, vec3 viewDir) {
        float diff = max(dot(normal, lightDir), 0.0);
        vec3 h = normalize(lightDir + viewDir);
        float spec = pow(max(dot(normal, h), 0.0), 32.0);
        return baseColor * diff + vec3(0.3) * spec;
    }

    Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
        vec2 uv = (fragCoord - 0.5 * iResolution.xy) / iResolution.y;
        return Ray(vec3(0.0, 0.0, 3.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -1.0)));
    }

    Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float dist) {
        vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
        if (iMouse.z <= 0.0) mouse = vec2(0.35, 0.45);
        float theta = 6.28 * mouse.x;
        float phi = 3.14 * (mouse.y - 0.5);
        ray.origin = dist * vec3(cos(phi)*sin(theta), sin(phi), cos(phi)*cos(theta));
        vec3 forward = normalize(-ray.origin);
        vec3 right = normalize(cross(vec3(0,1,0), forward));
        vec3 up = cross(forward, right);
        mat3 rot = mat3(right, up, forward);
        ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
        return ray;
    }

    void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
        Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
        ray = orbitRay(ray, 4.0);

        float t = raymarch(ray);

        vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
        if (t > 0.0) {
            vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
            vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
            vec3 baseColor = vec3(0.2, 0.7, 0.9);
            vec3 ambient = baseColor * 0.15;
            color = ambient + shade(normal, baseColor, light, -ray.dir);
        }

        fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
    }

    void main() {
        mainImage(gl_FragColor, gl_FragCoord.xy);
    }
  `;
  createShaderCanvas(canvas, shader);
  return canvas;
}
```


## dodecahedron

3D raymarched dodecahedron — same folds as icosahedron, different final face.

```{ojs}
//| label: dodecahedron
viewof dodecahedronCanvas = {
  const canvas = DOM.canvas(540, 540);
  const shader = `
    precision highp float;
    uniform vec2 iResolution;
    uniform float iTime;
    uniform vec4 iMouse;

    struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };

    const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
    const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
    const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

    const vec3 light = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));

    #define PHI (0.5 + 0.5 * sqrt(5.0))

    float sdDodecahedron(vec3 p, float r) {
        p = abs(p);

        vec3 n1 = normalize(vec3(0, 1, PHI));
        vec3 n2 = normalize(vec3(1, PHI, 0));
        vec3 n3 = normalize(vec3(PHI, 0, 1));

        // Same folds as icosahedron
        p -= 2.0 * min(dot(p, n1), 0.0) * n1;
        p -= 2.0 * min(dot(p, n2), 0.0) * n2;
        p -= 2.0 * min(dot(p, n3), 0.0) * n3;

        // Different face normal (pentagonal face)
        vec3 fn = normalize(vec3(0, 1.0/PHI, PHI));
        return dot(p, fn) - r;
    }

    float sdScene(vec3 p) {
        return sdDodecahedron(p, 1.1);
    }

    vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
        float eps = 0.001;
        return normalize(vec3(
            sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
            sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
            sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
        ));
    }

    float raymarch(Ray ray) {
        float t = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
            vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
            float d = sdScene(p);
            if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;
            t += d;
            if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
        }
        return -1.0;
    }

    vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 baseColor, vec3 lightDir, vec3 viewDir) {
        float diff = max(dot(normal, lightDir), 0.0);
        vec3 h = normalize(lightDir + viewDir);
        float spec = pow(max(dot(normal, h), 0.0), 32.0);
        return baseColor * diff + vec3(0.3) * spec;
    }

    Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
        vec2 uv = (fragCoord - 0.5 * iResolution.xy) / iResolution.y;
        return Ray(vec3(0.0, 0.0, 3.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -1.0)));
    }

    Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float dist) {
        vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
        if (iMouse.z <= 0.0) mouse = vec2(0.35, 0.45);
        float theta = 6.28 * mouse.x;
        float phi = 3.14 * (mouse.y - 0.5);
        ray.origin = dist * vec3(cos(phi)*sin(theta), sin(phi), cos(phi)*cos(theta));
        vec3 forward = normalize(-ray.origin);
        vec3 right = normalize(cross(vec3(0,1,0), forward));
        vec3 up = cross(forward, right);
        mat3 rot = mat3(right, up, forward);
        ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
        return ray;
    }

    void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
        Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
        ray = orbitRay(ray, 4.0);

        float t = raymarch(ray);

        vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
        if (t > 0.0) {
            vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
            vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
            vec3 baseColor = vec3(0.9, 0.4, 0.6);
            vec3 ambient = baseColor * 0.15;
            color = ambient + shade(normal, baseColor, light, -ray.dir);
        }

        fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
    }

    void main() {
        mainImage(gl_FragColor, gl_FragCoord.xy);
    }
  `;
  createShaderCanvas(canvas, shader);
  return canvas;
}
```
